candidate_evidence: Beard candidate; prior validation AUC 0.562 and controlled spatial enrichment 3.228, with unreviewed detector labels.
control_selection: Activity-matched to feature 2893 on the open-prompt East Asian man cohort (mean spatial-max 23.63 vs 23.91; active in 100% of images for each). Previously used as a random control in another exploratory study; not guaranteed semantically neutral.

conditions.bearded: a clearly visible full beard and moustache

prompt_template: a studio portrait photo of an East Asian man with short hair and {facial_hair}, neutral expression, wearing a plain white T-shirt against a plain white background
output_intervention: block output plus (multiplier - 1) times the original SAE feature coefficient times its decoder direction; reconstruction error is preserved; multiplier 1 is the exact no-op.
post_activation_map: SAE re-encoding of the intervened block residual (edited output minus block input), captured inside the feature hook before the next layer.
labels: Visual review is required; the supplied prompts are conditions, not verified beard labels.
